images.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Generate exactly ONE 1254x1254 PNG, a 2x2 sprite sheet of four square 627x627 cells, row-major, no borders, labels or gutters, on flat pure #00ff00. Reference image 1 is the approved identity master; reference image 2 is walk frames 0–3 and is the exact size, head size, baseline, camera, lighting and brushwork guide. Continue this same in-place south-facing walk toward the camera with frames 4–7, the opposite half-cycle. Top left frame 4 CONTACT: anatomical LEFT foot (screen right) forward planted, right foot back. Top right frame 5 RECOIL: weight onto left foot, knees compress, body lowest. Bottom left frame 6 PASSING: right leg swings forward past planted left leg, body rising. Bottom right frame 7 HIGH POINT: right foot about to plant forward, body highest, flows smoothly back to reference frame 0. Arms swing opposite legs. Keep plain walnut staff with brass ferrules in anatomical RIGHT hand (screen left) and olive canvas satchel on anatomical LEFT hip (screen right) throughout; never mirror. Match reference 2 exactly in overall figure scale, head scale, cell placement and common ground baseline, with only subtle gait bob. Entire hair, boots and staff fully inside each cell. Same young woman, dark curly hair tied back, ivory shirt, navy sleeveless tabard with plain chest, one diagonal chestnut harness to olive canvas satchel at left hip, one belt, laced bracers, navy trousers, chestnut boots, no insignia. Painted 2D high-resolution illustration, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, readable small silhouettes, no conspicuous brush or grain. Blue/ivory/brass palette. Fixed elevated three-quarter projection C camera; same south-facing orientation across all four cells. Single key light from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT fixed across all frames, deep cool low-value ambient with readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on key-facing silhouette. No spell glow, no additional warm or saturated light sources. No floor shadows, no environment, no matte or transparency. Do not zoom or rotate camera. Preserve reference identity, proportions, costume, staff and satchel without redesign. Native delivery is this sheet; downstream 512x512 frame registration by uniform downscale and translation is separate.
